data.body: Pushed Gerrit change 3045 (hashtag rebar-session-lane-04f1), rebased onto origin/main f147e08242f (lane 3's _mcp_llm.py dedup change merged cleanly; one textual conflict in docs/release-notes.md resolved by keeping both entries, newest first).
